about_the_game:
The Asili Forest has reclaimed a massive junkyard, and it's ripe for the picking! You have one goal: turn this overgrown wasteland of scrap into a multi-million dollar operation. The clock is ticking, the sun is blazing, and a fortune in precious metal awaits.

Start with nothing but your trusty truck and a keen eye. Dive into the sprawling junkyard to manually collect valuable materials—steel, copper, gold, and more. Haul your findings to the bank, track your profits, and start investing. Your business won't grow itself!

FEATURES

  • Build Your Automated Crew Why get your hands dirty? Use your profits to purchase and deploy automated drones to scour the yard from the air and hire workers to handle the heavy lifting on the ground.

  • Command Your Operation You're the boss. Manage your entire team of drones and workers right from the driver's seat of your truck while you hunt for the next big score.

  • Maintain Your Machines Your operation is only as good as its equipment. Keep your truck, drones, and workers in top condition. Hire a Repairman to fix breakdowns and prevent costly downtime.

  • Survive the Elements This isn't just a walk in the park. The HeatWave is a real threat! This dynamic hazard will test your management skills, damaging your units and slowing production. Adapt your strategy or go bankrupt.

  • Beat the Clock This isn't a leisurely Sunday drive. You are racing against time to build your fortune. Manage your day effectively to maximize every second before your time runs out!

  • Track Your Fortune Use the Bank interface to meticulously track your inventory, see what's selling, and watch your profits skyrocket.

  • Your Personal Soundtrack Manage your scrap empire to the beat of your own drum. The built-in music player lets you shuffle, skip, play, and pause tracks to create the perfect vibe for your hustle.

Do you have what it takes to conquer the Asili Forest Junkyard?
